card.name: Words just before a parent is named
card.fires_on: Linking or possessive words (since, her, his, dead, after, death of) in stories about loss, divorce or family hardship, right where the next word is likely 'parents', 'father' or 'mother'.

modes.label: Possessive before a parent
modes.description: A her/his/dead right after a loss or divorce event, before the parent is named.
modes.example: Aurora tells of the loss of<< her>> mother early in the poem

modes.label: Time link after family upheaval
modes.description: Words like since or after that lead into a parents' divorce or death.
modes.example: much like Sophie’s life<< since>> her parents’ divorce

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'parents' or similar family words next.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before the text mentions someone's parents, in stories about divorce or a parent's death.
